environment.description: Same Django 4.2 application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate behind CloudFront distribution. CloudFront is configured with a Response Headers Policy (ID: managed-policy-id-67890) that appends security headers to ALL origin responses before delivery to clients. The policy includes a custom Content-Security-Policy header value. Additionally, the ECS task definition includes a sidecar Envoy proxy with a Lua filter that validates response content-type and conditionally applies header overrides. The CloudFront Response Headers Policy specifies: 'Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://cdn.example.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src *; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'self'' with override-origin=true, ensuring the header is present even if the origin sets a different value. The Envoy sidecar additionally strips any CSP headers from the origin response to prevent conflicts with CloudFront's policy injection.
